# UI Kit Standard — LLM Context & Codebase Map

> UI Kit Standard is a Full-Stack Multi-Tenant SaaS Design System Studio & Master XML Specification Generator for AI Vibe Coding (Cursor, Claude, Copilot).

## Core Architecture
- Backend: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB Atlas, xmlbuilder2, DeepSeek-V3 AI engine
- Frontend: Vite, React 18, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons
- Key Output: Master XML Specification with RFC 2119 Directives (MUST, MUST_NOT)

## Key Source Files
- Project Specification: [UI_Kit_Standard_Sidebar_Specification.md](UI_Kit_Standard_Sidebar_Specification.md)
- Knowledge Summaries: [knowledge_summaries.md](knowledge_summaries.md)
- Codebase Index: [CODEBASE_INDEX.md](CODEBASE_INDEX.md)
